runtime: Latch only from the first actual observation after shared release. The two references use the same fixed parent. The candidate runs the bounded trained policy in latched supine scenes and returns exact parent actions for all other scenes. Audit the latch in native CUDA, then from saved actual observations independently replay both branches and the combined action at several controls. The original policy and controller interfaces are retained.
gate: Original 95 percent timely and final hold in all requested and actual poses and overall, minimum 32 samples per actual pose, at least two actual-supine net gains against both references, and no net non-supine pose loss. Record repeated-reference drift and source 11-second original media. Require actual CUDA zero-step and Windows-ready observation before any sampling. Do not select from the final holdout.
